A1.prompt_constraints: Use polite です/ます style only. Allowed particles: は, が, を, に, の, と, で, も. Simple noun and adjective sentences. Do NOT use て-form, plain past (た), plain negative (ない), ている, conditionals (ば/たら/なら), potential, causative, passive, relative clauses, or keigo. Spell each word as it appears in the allowed-word list.

A2.prompt_constraints: です/ます is still the default. て-form, てください, plain past た, and plain negative ない are allowed. Time expressions and counters OK. Do NOT use ている aspect, conditionals (ば/たら/なら), potential られる/える, causative させる, passive られる, relative clauses (verb modifying a noun), or keigo.

B1.prompt_constraints: ている aspect, potential, causative, てあげる/もらう/くれる, and simple relative clauses are welcome. Conditionals ば/たら/なら OK. Do NOT use passive られる as a voice, and do NOT use keigo (いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, いたします, ございます, いただく as humble/honorific).

B2.prompt_constraints: Passive, keigo (です/ます plus modest honorifics), auxiliary stacking, and N3-style conditionals are allowed. Calibrate vocabulary to B2 / N3–N2. Avoid classical 文語 and rare C1 literary patterns.
